version: Home Auth Register Google Return G2-r35

proposed_behavior.cancelled: Return to the original Register form without error/toast/local-field validation or automatic OTP. Preserve appropriate draft only while Auth remains open and active.
proposed_behavior.failed: For verified Google Auth failure, form-level Google message below local fields before primary; explicit Google retry and local alternative retained. Do not falsely mark email/phone/Username/password invalid.
proposed_behavior.message: ดำเนินการด้วย Google ไม่สำเร็จ / ลองอีกครั้ง หรือใช้ช่องทางอื่น
proposed_behavior.independence: Local email-signup required fields do not gate the Google action. No local signup request merely from Google cancellation/failure.
proposed_behavior.close: Separate from Google cancellation: dismissing Auth clears all form draft under the accepted rule and returns to Home origin.
proposed_behavior.success: Existing accepted Google signup flow only; no extra local email verification or forced Username/phone/password completion. Actual account/session/provider identity remains unimplemented.
proposed_behavior.provider_boundary: No popup/redirect policy, raw provider errors, account-existence claim, account creation rollback or automatic retry selected.

question: ใช้สองสถานะกลับฟอร์มสมัครนี้ได้ไหมครับ? 1. ใช้ทั้งคู่ 2. ปรับตอนยกเลิก 3. ปรับตอน Google ไม่สำเร็จ

verification.form_feedback_order_verified: After Username/phone/email/password/confirmation, before primary; one Google-specific form-level region.
verification.observation: Two complete forms visible, retained draft/fields, Google-only feedback before primary and retry near provider control; no visible clipping. Static design only.
